'''Retinal controllers''' were periphals that could be used with [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]]. The retinal controller allowed the user to control the datapad via eye movements.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
